globalNotes: Source AST generates typed properties and component wrappers; these hand-authored native adapters implement portable behavior. This is not arbitrary TSX/CSS machine translation.

No JavaScript functions, DOM selectors, CSS cascade/parts, nativeEvent objects or imperative HTMLElement methods are executed. Control components using property updates and consume serializable events.
AWCGeneratedTokens.light/dark supply native primary, secondary, tertiary, error, surface, onPrimary and onSurface colors.
Material glyphs generally map to common SF Symbols. md-button bundles the web Roboto and Material Symbols fonts. Native platform text/gesture/focus behavior applies.
Source HTMLElement methods are not implemented. Components use declarative properties; explicit native AWCFormState, event scopes and URL routers provide documented host APIs.

notes: Dedicated native Button uses source size/density metrics, variant/toggle/disabled color tokens, Roboto and Material Symbols fonts, slot fallback, and source loader placement.

Actual SwiftUI isPressed drives shape morphing (200ms press, 400ms release). Pointer-origin ripple uses source farthest-corner geometry and 450ms growth/150ms fade; hover and pointer geometry are forwarded by the native preview. Reduce Motion suppresses shape/ripple animations. Per-instance CSS overrides are not reproduced.

Loading draws the source 48-vertex morphing polygons with the original 4.55s keyframes and easing; Reduce Motion uses the source opacity pulse. Native button groups do not automatically inject connected corner props. RTL icon mirroring uses native layout direction; expanded trailing-icon rotation requires an explicit aria-expanded property on the native node.
mdClick describes the proposed state before commit and includes value, toggle, selected, href and target; mdChange follows commit and includes selected and value. originalEvent is omitted.

AWCButtonAction synchronously dispatches cancelable mdClick through AWCEventScope before any toggle, routing or form action. Legacy onEvent observes the result through AWCEvent.defaultPrevented; mdChange follows a committed toggle. Native form state and URL routing are explicit equivalents, not HTML/DOM emulation. Soft-disabled controls suppress activation without preserving web keyboard focusability.

type submit/reset uses the nearest AWCFormScope. Named text/number/OTP/select/multi-select/autocomplete, checkbox and switch controls register by stable per-view identity; other values can register explicitly. Reset restores first-registered values and native bindings. target is carried to an injectable AWCURLRouter; the default SwiftUI openURL fallback does not reproduce browser target contexts. Any raw nonempty href, including an unsafe one, suppresses form actions.

HTML_FORM.description: Explicit native field registration, values, validation, submit and reset-to-initial state. The actual md-button type submit/reset uses the nearest native scope.
limitations: Native required, length, numeric range, ICU-pattern and custom validation differ from HTML constraint validation and browser validation UI.
Only documented control families auto-register; other values require explicit registration. Checkbox/switch values use native booleans rather than HTML successful-control serialization.
No ElementInternals, implicit Enter submission, HTML form owner lookup, HTTP form encoding or browser submit/reset event semantics.

CANCELABLE_EVENT.description: Synchronous inner-to-outer native scopes can prevent md-button default actions or stop propagation. Cancellation precedes toggle, URL and form effects; legacy onEvent remains an observer.
limitations: No DOM capture phase, composed/shadow retargeting, originalEvent or underlying browser click event.
Propagation follows explicitly installed native scopes; only the md-button activation is cancelable in this adapter.

DOM_GLOBAL.description: Safe explicit URL routing carries URL, original href, target and node identity to a host handler. Raw rejected links cannot fall through into form actions.
limitations: No window/document object or browser browsing-context creation. The host decides how to interpret target; default openURL ignores browsing targets.
Relative URLs require an explicit base URL. URL schemes and control characters are validated using native rules rather than the browser URL parser.

SHADOW_DOM.description: An explicit native component tree owns nested content and rendering without accessing browser shadow roots.
limitations: This replaces component content ownership; it does not implement CSS shadow-tree encapsulation or DOM retargeting.

DOM_QUERY.description: Typed tree traversal finds native descendants by stable node ID or source tag without querying browser elements.
limitations: Supports explicit native ID/tag lookup, not arbitrary CSS selectors, live DOM collections or imperative HTMLElement references.

SLOT_INTROSPECTION.description: Native named-child lookup and dynamic fallback are used by md-button for default content, leading/trailing icons and loader.
limitations: Operates on declarative native child values; browser assignedElements, slotchange events and flattened DOM slot semantics do not exist.

notes: Icons map Material names to SF Symbols; raw SF Symbol names are accepted. Arbitrary Material glyph coverage is not guaranteed.
Coordinates selected children.
Coordinates selected child indices and values. Native selection payload omits DOM button references.
mdSelectionChange includes values, added and removed; originalEvent is omitted.
Native name groups share selected values within a nested tree or an explicit AWCNativeScope. The host can also update checked declaratively.
Native keyboard input and secure entry. Change commits on submit; HTML validity flags beyond required, JS formatter/parser/restrict and speech recognition remain unsupported.
clearable/passwordToggle external modes emit intent without mutating native state; internal and boolean true modes perform the change.
Native text entry uses decimal dot. Bounds constrain steppers; locale formatting and arbitrary typed out-of-range normalization are not implemented.
Single native one-time-code input with visual cells, sanitation, paste handling and completion. Per-cell focus and autoSubmit differ from web.
Range uses two accessible native sliders. Vertical layout, centered track, tick marks and DOM thumb metadata are not implemented.
Range value events retain source value plus valueStart/valueEnd. Drag events include value fields and thumb single/start/end.
Tap an already full star to choose its half value when precision is 0.5. Native hover preview is not implemented.
Native searchable sheet replaces anchored web listbox. Default-slot select-option children are parsed as option data.
Selection supports chips, remove, clear, disabled options and maximum count; count/text layout and anchor placement differ.
Native searchable sheet, free-form submit and multiple selection. Custom JS filtering and virtualization not executed.
System DatePicker replaces Material calendar and its month/year menus. Date objects serialize to ISO strings. Bounds are supported; predicate callbacks are not.
System DatePicker replaces dial/input variants. Event dates serialize to ISO strings. MinuteStep/12-hour labels and overnight bounds are not supported.
System ColorPicker. Serializes RGB as hex; alpha can be picked but alpha serialization, alternate formats and programmatic open remain unsupported.
AsyncImage loads remote images. Native image cache/loading replaces browser loading/crossorigin.
Native semantic color dot; flashing live indicator not implemented.
Static native skeleton; CSS percentage dimensions and pulse/wave animation are not implemented.
Uses native determinate/indeterminate progress. Expressive wave/four-color animations not implemented.
Native pressed state feedback, not CSS radial ripple geometry.
Native rounded surface; DOM MutationObserver role inference and draggable positioning are not implemented.
Coordinates child expansion, exclusive mode and keep-one-open. Dragging/reorder/floating/window positioning not implemented.
Event item DOM references become stable native node IDs. Nested focus and keyboard reorder are not implemented.
Coordinates native child selection. DOM references in events become native node IDs.
Preserves authored child order and native horizontal/vertical layout.
Native rail expansion event supplied, but responsive maxVisible/overflow/modal positioning are not implemented.
Updates linked md-tab-panels within the same native tree or AWCNativeScope using native node IDs.
Submenu expansion not implemented.
The for property matches an md-tabs native node ID within the same tree or AWCNativeScope. Browser DOM querying and stable max-height measuring are not reproduced.
Native event has index and href; DOM MouseEvent omitted.
Native linear/nonlinear progression. mdBeforeChange is an observation; it cannot cancel via preventDefault. Layout is vertical in this adapter.
System sheet replaces browser modal. Built-in trigger supports playground/native standalone usage; open can also be supplied externally.
System sheet detents replace detached/standard CSS layouts.
System sheet replaces desktop side edge positioning.
Native expandable menu surface; anchor selectors and popover collision placement have no native equivalent.
Tap opens submenu. Browser pointer hover delays not implemented.
Native inline snackbar surface, not global window overlay stacking.
Tap toggles native details surface; hover delays and viewport anchor positioning not implemented.
Native search field. App must supply filtered result children; no implicit content filtering. Voice recognition and debounce are not implemented.
Native scroll container. minHeight, elevation and shape variants not reproduced.

Native composed rows; sorts source row cell text/numbers by column and coordinates row selection. Event DOM references become IDs. Column pinning, spans, visibility and sticky headers remain unsupported.
mdSelectionChange includes count, total, values, all and indeterminate; header checkbox selects all eligible rows.
Native equal-flex columns; colSpan/rowSpan and sticky pinning are not supported.
Positive page sizes supported; web -1 all-rows sentinel and format templates are not implemented.
Routes native internal awcExpand to containing row.
Native dual-list transfer supports disabled options, checked selection, select-all, per-side search and directional moves.
Native indented tree. Horizontal node layout and browser keyboard roving-focus scheme are not implemented.

Native Canvas plots. Supports scalar/y/value points and gaps; linear curves, unstacked single-axis. Tap probes first visible series. JS formatters, zoom, marks, multi-axis, stack, smooth curves and exact pointer event metadata remain unsupported.
Native Canvas area fill. Linear, unstacked, single axis. Tap probes first visible series. Browser advanced chart features listed unsupported.
Native Canvas grouped vertical bars. Stacking, polar, inverted/horizontal layout, custom axes and zoom not implemented. Tap probes first series.
Native Canvas pie/donut. Negative values clamp to zero. Hit testing supports full circle; custom partial sweeps are visual only. Gradients/ring widths and browser tooltip renderer unsupported.
Native Canvas sparkline, scalar/y/value data. Linear curves; referenceAreas and custom formatter not implemented.
